name: Acerra (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Acerra (a fleur-de-lis beneath a star on blue) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI ACERRA in white arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Acerra, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Acerra arms — fleur-de-lis beneath a star on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI ACERRA arched above the arms
